_comment: Curated, real, verifiable income platforms. Pay figures are ESTIMATES used only for ranking, not guarantees. Verify current terms on each site before investing time. requires_human=true means the earning step cannot be legitimately automated.

opportunities.title: HackerOne — public bug bounty programs
opportunities.description: Hundreds of companies pay for valid, in-scope security vulnerabilities. Newly launched programs tend to have more findable bugs. Only test authorized, in-scope targets.

opportunities.title: Bugcrowd — public bug bounty programs
opportunities.description: Crowdsourced security testing marketplace. Pays per validated vulnerability by severity. In-scope, authorized targets only.

opportunities.title: Google Bug Hunters (VRP)
opportunities.description: Direct vulnerability rewards program for Google products. High payouts for serious bugs; competitive.

opportunities.title: Intigriti — European bug bounty platform
opportunities.description: European-focused bounty platform with public and private programs. Pays per validated, in-scope finding.

opportunities.title: Algora — paid open-source bounties
opportunities.description: Companies attach cash bounties to GitHub issues; you get paid when your PR is merged. Real money for real code.

opportunities.title: IssueHunt — open-source issue bounties
opportunities.description: Bounties funded on open-source issues; paid on merged solutions.

opportunities.title: Respondent — paid B2B research studies
opportunities.description: Professionals get paid for interviews and studies in their field. Among the highest-paying legit research platforms for qualified participants.

opportunities.title: User Interviews — paid research participation
opportunities.description: Matches you to paid UX/market research studies. Honest, vetted, pays via PayPal/gift cards per completed study.

opportunities.title: Wynter — B2B message/landing-page testing
opportunities.description: B2B professionals get paid to give structured feedback on messaging. Short tasks, solid per-minute pay for qualified panelists.

opportunities.title: UserTesting — paid usability tests
opportunities.description: Record yourself using websites/apps and speaking your thoughts. ~$4-$120 per test. Requires webcam/voice — inherently human.

opportunities.title: uTest / Applause — paid software test cycles
opportunities.description: Get paid to test software, find bugs, and verify fixes across real devices. Pays per test cycle / per approved bug.

opportunities.title: Expert networks (GLG, AlphaSights, Guidepoint)
opportunities.description: Get paid for short consulting calls in your area of professional expertise. Often $100-$1000/hr for niche knowledge. Application + vetting required.

opportunities.title: Upwork — freelance marketplace
opportunities.description: Largest freelance marketplace. Real rates depend on skill; software/security/writing can command $30-$200+/hr. Competitive to start.

opportunities.title: Contra — commission-free freelance
opportunities.description: Freelance platform with no commission fees. Good for design, dev, and marketing gigs.

opportunities.title: Clickworker — micro-tasks / AI data
opportunities.description: Short data, categorization, and AI-training tasks. Honest but low pay; useful only as filler. Automation is prohibited.

opportunities.title: Amazon Mechanical Turk — HITs
opportunities.description: Micro-tasks (HITs). Mostly pennies; a skilled worker may reach a few dollars/hr. Bots are banned; many HITs are research data where automation is fraud.

opportunities.title: Medium Partner Program — writing royalties
opportunities.description: Earn from member reading time on your articles. Slow ramp; rewards genuine, quality writing. AI-spam is penalized.

opportunities.title: Affiliate networks (Impact, PartnerStack, ShareASale)
opportunities.description: Earn commissions referring products you genuinely use. Legit, but needs an audience/traffic and ramps over weeks/months.

opportunities.title: Survey / paid-to-click / GPT sites (Swagbucks, InboxDollars, etc.)
opportunities.description: Watch ads, click links, complete surveys. Tracked ONLY to warn you off: payouts are pennies, ToS prohibits automation, and bots get banned with balances forfeited. Survey automation is data fraud.
